metadata.rr_version: rr-linux-arm64 version 3.0.1 (build time: 2026-10-21T19:34:04+0000, go1.27.3), OS: linux, arch: arm64
metadata.php_platform_preparation: External local platform: cached zerno-security-php:8.5.12 plus libpq-dev and compiled pdo_pgsql; not part of project checks/build.
metadata.php_platform_dockerfile:
FROM zerno-security-php:8.5.12
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y libpq-dev \
    && docker-php-ext-install -j2 pdo_pgsql \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

method.rss_windows: Median of samples in first and last 60 s after warmup. Drain sample beyond nominal 900 s excluded. RSS sums count shared pages more than once.
method.cpu: Delta Linux /proc stat utime+stime divided by CLK_TCK; percentage is of one CPU core.
method.scope: Regular-file responses, small SQL reads, JSON and intentional errors; not client cancellation, DB outages, other streams or multi-day deployment.
method.background_activity: Repository verification and one runtime-archive CLI smoke ran on the same host during the first part of measurement. This is not an isolated throughput comparison.
method.security: No new online security audit; Linux arm64 binary is not covered by the separate Linux amd64 not-affected assessment.
method.latency: k6 http_req_duration = sending + waiting + receiving. Client SHA-256 verification belongs to iteration_duration, not HTTP latency.
